system: civil law influenced by Soviet and continental European civil law systems; legislature retains power to interpret statutes

constitution.amend: proposed by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress or supported by more than one fifth of the National People's Congress membership; passage requires more than two-thirds majority vote of the Congress membership

courts.highest: Supreme People's Court (consists of over 340 judges, including the chief justice and 13 grand justices organized into a civil committee and tribunals for civil, economic, administrative, complaint and appeal, and communication and transportation cases)
courts.judges: chief justice appointed by the People's National Congress (NPC); limited to 2 consecutive 5-year-terms; other justices and judges nominated by the chief justice and appointed by the Standing Committee of the NPC; term of other justices and judges determined by the NPC
courts.lower: Higher People's Courts; Intermediate People's Courts; District and County People's Courts; Autonomous Region People's Courts; International Commercial Courts; Special People's Courts for military, maritime, transportation, and forestry issues

citizenship.descent: least one parent must be a citizen of China
citizenship.residency: while naturalization is theoretically possible, in practical terms it is extremely difficult; residency is required but not specified

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
